name: 17801-longdecode-kimilinear48b-tp4
model: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, UNQUANTIZED, ungated on HF. ~49 B parameters, ~96 GB of weights, ~24 GB per card at TP4, ~3 B active per token. Not substitutable, and the unquantized weights are part of the declaration.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, four cards of one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier, no second node.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, no speculative decoding.
architecture: KimiLinearForCausalLM, 27 layers: 20 Kimi Delta Attention (linear, recurrent, fixed state per request) and 7 MLA, hidden_size 2304, sparse MoE with 256 routed experts at top-8 plus one shared expert, vocab 163840.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 512 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, streaming. 4000 prompt tokens against 1000 output tokens, both FIXED with no spread, temperature 0.0, ignore_eos true, seed 42. Decode-dominated by construction: one 4000-token prefill against 999 decode steps.
purpose: A long-form report writer turning 4,000-word briefs into 1,000-token drafts for 32 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The launch config, in `sglang serve` CLI form.
#
# FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line. An indented or nested block is DROPPED silently, so a
# structured value must stay on ONE line.

model-path: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 4

# Required by the checkpoint: its tokenizer_config.json auto_map points at remote code.
trust-remote-code: true

# The engine's RNG, written down rather than left to chance. Sampling is greedy.
random-seed: 42
